Class MapLayerStyle

java.lang.Object
edu.cnu.mdi.mapping.layer.MapLayerStyle
public class MapLayerStyle extends Object
Mutable style values used by MapLayerStyleDialog.

Only values corresponding to enabled capability bits are presented by the dialog. The same object can therefore be used by several different map-layer types.
